The '''duel on Maryx Minor''' was a duel that occurred between [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] and [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] on [[Maryx Minor/Legends|Maryx Minor]] in [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]].
